newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes final pre-Christmas session up.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes final pre-Christmas session up.

text.p: 1500 GMT - Czech shares close higher on Monday, the last trading day until Friday.
* On bourse as a whole, 186 shares rise, 201 fall, 118 unchanged. Turnover, one billion crowns, volume 1,987,255 shares
The Czech PX50 index closed off the last pre-Christmas session with a small rise helped by a late rebound from major issues.
The PX50 rose 1.3 points to 531.1. The bourse will be closed until Friday for the Christmas break.
Dealers said the market, as expected, was very quiet although there was some activity in investment funds.
"I've seen some activity in the funds...but nothing major. Today is very quiet. Basically most of the traders are already on holiday," said Lubomir Vystavel of ING Barings in Prague.
